name: Connected Minimal-Non-Ample Classes Are Not Projection-Closed
statement: Let $H$ have $n$ active coordinates and VC dimension $k\ge2$. Its projection to $Z$ is $Q_Z$ for $|Z|\le k$, is the connected antipodally punctured cube $Q_{k+1}^{--}$ for $|Z|=k+1$, and remains connected conditioning-minimal non-ample of VC dimension $k$ for $|Z|>k+1$. Thus the class is not projection-closed.
proof: Uniform-oriented-matroid deletion gives the three cases. The middle and large cases remain non-free simple UOM tope graphs and hence connected; the small case is a cube. In particular, projecting the six-cycle to two coordinates gives the full square.
